source: SP 14.13330.2018: the intensity of the site (MSK-64) from the OSR-2015 maps A, B, C by the responsibility (4.3) and the soil category I-IV (Table 1: I one point less, III one point more), the design seismic load Sik = K0 K1 S0ik with S0ik = Qk A β(Ti) Kψ ηik (5.5): A 0.1, 0.2, 0.4 g for 7, 8, 9 points, β(T) by the soil category (5.6, at least 0.8), K0 by the purpose (Table 3, the occupancy's seismic importance), K1 by the allowed damage of the system (Table 5, R = 1/K1), Kψ 1.0 for buildings (Table 4); the modal method with the modes to 90 % of the mass and the combination of 5.10-5.11 (SRSS, the close modes T ratio >= 0.9 by CQC); ηk of the first mode taken linear for the static method (5.5); the height limits by the system and intensity (Table 8, U). Every value is in VERIFY.md (the tables written from memory: U).

I.description: Category I: rock, frozen rock and coarse soils (the site one point below the map: S 0.5; β(T) of categories I-II)

II.description: Category II: weathered rock, dense and medium sands, clays of IL <= 0.5 (the map's intensity: S 1; β(T) of categories I-II)

III.description: Category III: loose sands, clays of IL > 0.5 (the site one point above the map: S 2; β(T) of categories III-IV)

IV.description: Category IV: very soft soils (a site-specific study; category III assumed meanwhile)
